stem:
Advik tests a paste of crushed beans. He adds a few drops of copper sulphate solution and then caustic soda solution. The mixture turns violet.

Which statements correctly read this protein-test result? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: The violet colour shows that protein is present in the beans.
The protein test used copper sulphate solution and caustic soda solution, and violet means protein is present.
The violet colour shows that starch is present in the beans.
Protein is absent because any laboratory chemical was added, even though the colour is violet.

teacher.key_rationale: Violet after copper sulphate and caustic soda indicates protein. Starch is a different nutrient test; adding chemicals alone does not prove protein is absent when violet appears.
